title: Porsche Aircooled Piston and Cylinder Assembly Instruction Manual
notes: May 2020 assembly manual describes aftermarket pistons machined from forgings with phosphate treatment and proprietary GRAFAL skirt coating. It explicitly identifies the kits as modern adaptations rather than exact copies of original parts. Gauge location is measured from the skirt bottom, and clearance is measured over the coating. Does not give coating or piston crown thickness. Acquisition: HTTP 200 on 2026-10-03. Edition/publication metadata: 2020-05 (5/20 on final page).
